name: declaration-record
title: Declaration and assessment record
for_each: select id,code from disclosures order by code

sections.title: Declared interest
sections.sql: select d.code,p.name as person,d.title,d.kind,d.entity,d.details,d.declared_on,d.revision from disclosures d join people p on p.id=d.person_id where d.id=$1

sections.title: Assessments and their evidence
sections.sql: select r.revision,p.name as reviewer,r.outcome,r.rationale,r.evidence,r.created_at from reviews r join people p on p.id=r.reviewer_id where disclosure_id=$1 order by sequence

sections.title: Record changes
sections.sql: select actor,action,note,created_at from activity where record_id=$1 order by sequence

name: management-plan
title: Conflict management plan
for_each: select d.id,d.code from disclosures d join v_latest_reviews r on r.disclosure_id=d.id where not d.archived and r.outcome='manage'

sections.title: Declared interest
sections.sql: select d.code,p.name as person,d.title,d.kind,d.entity,d.details,d.declared_on,d.revision from disclosures d join people p on p.id=d.person_id where d.id=$1

sections.title: Latest recorded plan
sections.note: Compare reviewed revision to current revision. A stale plan needs fresh assessment.
sections.sql: select r.revision as reviewed_revision,d.revision as current_revision,r.plan,p.name as monitor,r.next_review_on,r.evidence from v_latest_reviews r join disclosures d on d.id=r.disclosure_id left join people p on p.id=r.monitor_id where d.id=$1

sections.title: Actions
sections.sql: select a.code,p.name as owner,a.title,a.due_on,a.status,a.evidence from actions a join people p on p.id=a.owner_id where disclosure_id=$1 order by a.due_on

name: round-summary
title: Declaration round committee record
for_each: select id,code from campaigns order by code

sections.title: Round
sections.sql: select code,title,due_on from campaigns where id=$1

sections.title: Returns
sections.sql: select p.name,p.department,q.response,q.evidence,q.responded_at from requests q join people p on p.id=q.person_id where campaign_id=$1 order by p.name

sections.title: Linked disclosures
sections.sql: select d.code,d.title,v.position from disclosures d join requests q on q.id=d.request_id join v_register v on v.id=d.id where q.campaign_id=$1 order by d.code
